# Product Video integration

Upstream revision: `5e71af35a2daee492dd3ea93e5e8903f32dcd13c`.

The original motion library is incorporated into Product Video. Modified source routes copy, glyph animation, media, fonts and themes through scoped project settings. The workbench adds narration, captions, transitions, project preparation and the shared export path. Original dependency and audio licenses remain in force.

Additional integration sources live in `workbench/src/product-video`, `workbench/scripts/product-video.mjs` and the parent Product Video Python engine. `assets/clips/clipcard-demo.mp4` is a synthetic FFmpeg test pattern with silent audio. Generated catalogues and dependency manifests are part of this adaptation.

## Content layouts in Product Video 2.1

`workbench/src/product-video/Editorial.tsx` and `EditorialMotion.tsx` bind project images, captions, typography, colors and timing to reusable content layouts. The motion implementation adapts upstream row-embed, card-flip and shared motion primitives. Overview, portal, fan, full, side and pair layouts are Product Video integration components, not additional upstream catalogue entries.

Duration-driven cards now use the actual clip duration instead of freezing at their library preview length. Export verification uses an integer FFmpeg timeout, including fractional-second long videos. `scripts/verify-media.mjs` owns that validation and is exercised by the integration tests.
